summary: Butyl alcohol (butanol) is a solvent used in small amounts in some topical and liquid formulations.
indications: Used as a solvent in combination products; it has no therapeutic indication of its own

dosage.d: No therapeutic dose; present as a solvent
dosage.n: The dose is that of the product's active ingredients

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Formulation role only; no therapeutic action at the amounts used.
preg: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
lact: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
refs: Martindale: The Complete Drug Reference (Pharmaceutical Press)
